title: Make It Safe: How to Make It Safe to Talk About Almost Anything
heading: Chapter 6
chapterLocalFacts: Safety depends on Mutual Purpose and Mutual Respect at the same time.
Apology is for real contribution to harm, not generic soothing.
Contrasting corrects a false misread of intent and only works when sincere.
CRIB rebuilds shared purpose when the fight is really over strategies.
bridgeForward: Chapter 7 teaches how to put a difficult message into the pool once safety has been restored.
